spec2def(bcryptprimitives.dll bcryptprimitives.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# bcryptprimitives.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/bcryptprimitives-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(bcryptprimitives_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(bcryptprimitives_shims PRIVATE libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(bcryptprimitives_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(bcryptprimitives_shims)
add_cargo_module(bcryptprimitives bcryptprimitives-cargo bcryptprimitives.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS bcryptprimitives_shims)
